Además de instalarlo, «hermes memory set: Besides installing it, «hermes memory setup» makes MimirSynth that profile's memory provider.
Añade el servidor a tu cliente: Add the server to your client
Codex solo ejecuta los hooks de un plugi: Codex only runs a plugin's hooks once you trust them: open /hooks in Codex and trust the three «mimirsynth» ones. For the MCP server, export MIMIRSYNTH_TOKEN with the token first.
Crea o elige un token y aquí verás cuánd: Create or pick a token and you will see here when the agent's first call arrives.
Da al modelo las herramientas de MimirSy: Gives the model MimirSynth's tools (recall, remember, facts_about…) on top of what the plugin does.
El brain ha respondido, pero nada de lo: The brain answered, but nothing it knows is close enough to this question. In a new brain that is normal: try another one, or come back once there is memory.
El secreto de un token solo se muestra a: A token's secret is shown only when it is created: the snippets carry «mst_…» where yours goes.
Elige tu agente y copia lo que necesita,: Pick your agent and copy what it needs, already filled in with this server, this brain and a token. It turns green as soon as the agent makes its first call.
Esperando la primera llamada del agente…: Waiting for the agent's first call…
La dirección del servidor MCP del brain: The address of the brain's MCP server and the header of every request.
La forma «mcpServers» que leen la mayorí: The «mcpServers» form most MCP clients read. Streamable HTTP transport, stateless; all it needs is a client that can send a header.
O configúralo a mano: Or set it up by hand
OpenClaw pide aceptar las capacidades de: OpenClaw asks you to accept the plugin's capabilities, and the setup offers to grant the conversation access its recall needs.
Primera llamada con «{{name}}» el {{at}}: First call with «{{name}}» on {{at}}. Recalls made with it so far: {{n}}.
Todos los plugins de MimirSynth leen est: Every MimirSynth plugin reads this file, on any system (on Windows, inside your user folder). If you already have one, change only these keys. Keep it readable only by you: it holds the token.
Token «{{name}}» creado. Ya va en los fr: Token «{{name}}» created. It is already in the snippets below: copy them now, because it is not shown again.
Un recall de prueba: lo que recibe el ag: A test recall: what the agent receives
Una línea, en un terminal. Si después pr: One line, in a terminal. If it then asks for the URL, the brain or the token, it already finds them in the file: press Enter to keep each one.
Una vista previa: no cuenta como un reca: A preview: it does not count as the agent's recall and is not logged.
Ábrelo (o ejecuta su comando de estado): Open it (or run its status command) once it is installed. This turns green a few seconds after it uses the token.
